name: Dr. Khan Mohammad Al Farabi
title: Post Doc Research Associate
bio: Dr. Khan Mohammad Al Farabi is presently a Postdoctoral Fellow at the ASSIST Lab, Florida Institute of Technology, USA, under the mentorship of Dr. Siddhartha Bhattacharyya. His research interests include Explainable Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Formal Methods, Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, Markov Logic Networks, and Deep Learning.
